record.title: Review captured ADC evidence and correct future nested indexing
record.intent: Establish explicit offline evidence completeness while retaining the stock run's frozen index rejection.
requirements: Preserve stock-adc-input-capture-01 raw files, original index, original source and failed frozen verifier unchanged. Do not rerun the guest or reclassify that frozen result as accepted.

Independently verify the complete consumed artifact set, raw capture checksums and sizes, all existing index entries, and the eight omitted static contracts against frozen source pins; record a separate review manifest with the exact coverage limitation.

Correct future runner indexing to cover the declared nested static-contract artifacts and exercise the actual runner_index function with positive, missing-file, modified-file and duplicate-index controls. Avoid a different recursive index builder in the integration test.
Preserve capture semantics and the native binary. Commit and push the review and prospective harness correction before successor execution work.
acceptance: An explicit offline completeness conclusion and tested future index correction are committed and pushed without altering the completed experiment.
